lotInfo:
The Successful Bidder of this lot will be required to sign and date a Medical Statement of Intent and send to melinda.jenkins@gsa.gov prior to remitting full payment and initiating removal.

Overview

Siemens Acuson S1000 portable ultrasound system in repairable condition. This advanced diagnostic ultrasound platform supports general imaging, vascular, cardiac, OB/GYN, and musculoskeletal assessments. The system provides high-resolution imaging capabilities, multiple Doppler modes, elastography functions, and comprehensive measurement packages. It features a standard console layout with LCD display and supports multi-modality workflows. The unit includes installed software as currently configured, power cabling, and four probes (9L4, 4CL, 4V1, and 14L5). Hard drive has been removed.

Key Features

  • Advanced diagnostic ultrasound platform with high-resolution imaging capabilities.
  • Multiple Doppler modes and elastography functions.
  • Comprehensive measurement packages for clinical assessments.
  • Multi-modality workflow support with standard console layout.
  • LCD display with physical controls and core functions.
  • Includes four ultrasound probes: 9L4, 4CL, 4V1, and 14L5.

Condition & Markings

  • This lot is in repairable condition. Parts are missing, and repairs are required.
  • Unit exhibits signs of normal cosmetic wear consistent with routine operational use.
  • Hard drive has been removed from the system.
  • All physical controls and core functions operate as intended unless otherwise noted.

Inspection and Removal

  • Inspection and Removal: Available Monday through Friday, by confirmed appointment only. The site is closed on federal holidays. Contact the property custodian (listed below) to schedule an appointment.
  • Property Inspection: Bidders are strongly encouraged to inspect the property prior to placing a bid to evaluate its condition and suitability. By bidding without an inspection, bidders assume the risk of potential omissions in the description.
  • Removal Responsibilities: The successful bidder is solely responsible for all aspects of removal, including packing, crating, banding, loading, and shipping. The agency will not provide assistance.
  • Authorized Third-Party Removal: The authorized third-party agent must present a Letter of Authorization from the high bidder (see terms and conditions for details), a copy of the purchasers receipt, and a valid photo ID at the time of removal.

Disclaimer

  • The condition of the property is not warranted. Pictures are not warranted.
